prompt_text: What is the best service to check if AI engines like ChatGPT recommend my small business?

Profound: Focuses specifically on measuring brand sentiment, tracking product/SKU visibility in ChatGPT Shopping, and verifying AI citation accuracy. Profound
SE Ranking (AI Visibility Tracker / SE Visible): Bundles traditional SEO with multi-engine tracking across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews, featuring "Not cited" reports to see where competitors appear instead of you. Trustmary
OtterlyAI: Offers budget-friendly tracking for multi-engine AI visibility (starting around $29/mo). Zapier
Peec AI: Tracks conversational query data and provides smart recommendations to improve your standing in AI responses. Zapier
ZipTie: Provides deep reporting and conversation tracking for AI-driven discovery. Zapier
Free Alternatives: Platforms like Semrush AI Search Visibility Checker, Ahrefs AI Visibility Checker, and SE Ranking offer entry-level or free checks to test domain mentions across major AI platforms.
